tasks.title: Implement View Count Persistence
tasks.description: Persist blog post view counts to a database.
tasks.details: 1. Choose a persistent storage solution (e.g., database field, Redis). 2. Modify the trackViewCount function in the blog post API route (app-next-directory/src/app/api/blog/[slug]/route.ts) to update the persistent store. 3. Ensure the view count is incremented correctly and persists across server restarts.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that view counts are correctly incremented and persisted in the database. Test the functionality by viewing a blog post and checking the database.

subtasks.title: Choose Persistent Storage Solution
subtasks.description: Select a database or other persistent storage mechanism for view counts.
subtasks.details: Evaluate options like a database field (e.g., in MongoDB), Redis, or other suitable solutions. Consider factors like performance, scalability, and ease of integration with the existing infrastructure. Document the chosen solution.

subtasks.title: Modify trackViewCount Function
subtasks.description: Update the trackViewCount function to interact with the chosen storage solution.
subtasks.details: Modify the `trackViewCount` function in `app-next-directory/src/app/api/blog/[slug]/route.ts` to increment the view count in the selected persistent store. Implement the necessary database queries or API calls to update the view count. Handle potential errors during the update process.

subtasks.title: Implement View Count Increment Logic
subtasks.description: Ensure view counts are correctly incremented for each blog post view.
subtasks.details: Implement the logic to increment the view count every time a blog post is viewed. Consider potential issues like concurrent requests and ensure the increment operation is atomic or properly synchronized to prevent data corruption. Handle edge cases such as bot traffic.

subtasks.title: Ensure Persistence Across Server Restarts
subtasks.description: Verify that view counts are not lost when the server restarts.
subtasks.details: Test the persistence of view counts by restarting the server and verifying that the counts are retained in the persistent storage. Implement any necessary mechanisms to ensure data durability, such as database transactions or periodic backups.

subtasks.title: Test View Count Persistence
subtasks.description: Thoroughly test the view count persistence functionality.
subtasks.details: View several blog posts and check the database to verify that the view counts are correctly incremented. Test the functionality by viewing a blog post, checking the database, restarting the server, and then checking the database again to ensure the view count persists. Test with different browsers and devices.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that view counts are correctly incremented and persisted in the database. Test the functionality by viewing a blog post and checking the database. Test persistence across server restarts.

tasks.testStrategy: Test the performance of bulk operations with a large number of items. Verify that the operations complete within an acceptable timeframe.

subtasks.title: Profile Bulk Operation Performance
subtasks.description: Profile the performance of existing bulk admin operations.
subtasks.details: Use profiling tools to identify performance bottlenecks in the sequential loop used in bulk admin operations. Analyze the time taken for different operations and identify areas for optimization.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run bulk operations with a small and medium number of items and measure the execution time. Use profiling tools to identify bottlenecks.

subtasks.title: Evaluate Parallel Processing
subtasks.description: Investigate the feasibility of parallelizing bulk operations.
subtasks.details: Explore the possibility of using parallel processing techniques (e.g., multithreading, multiprocessing, or asynchronous tasks) to execute bulk operations concurrently. Consider the overhead of parallelization and potential race conditions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Implement a parallel version of a bulk operation and compare its performance with the sequential version using a large dataset. Measure the execution time and resource utilization.

subtasks.title: Implement Backend-Side Batching
subtasks.description: Implement backend-side batching for database operations.
subtasks.details: Modify the backend code to batch database operations. Instead of performing individual database calls for each item in a bulk operation, group them into larger batches to reduce overhead. Consider using database-specific batching features.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test the performance of bulk operations with and without batching. Measure the execution time and database query count for different batch sizes.

subtasks.title: Monitor View Count Map
subtasks.description: Monitor the in-memory map for view counts and address scaling concerns.
subtasks.details: Implement monitoring for the in-memory map used to store view counts. Track memory usage and access patterns. Implement strategies to handle potential scaling issues, such as sharding or caching.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate a high-volume scenario and monitor the memory usage of the view count map. Verify that the system can handle the load without performance degradation or memory issues.

subtasks.title: Optimize Data Structures
subtasks.description: Optimize data structures used in bulk operations.
subtasks.details: Review the data structures used in bulk operations. Identify any potential inefficiencies and optimize them for performance. Consider using more efficient data structures or algorithms.
subtasks.testStrategy: Compare the performance of bulk operations with the original and optimized data structures. Measure the execution time and memory usage.

tasks.title: Improve Error Handling and Resilience
tasks.description: Improve error handling and resilience.
tasks.details: 1. Ensure that each component and API has fallback behavior or timeouts. 2. Handle missing analytics responses gracefully in the AdminDashboard. 3. Implement robust error handling throughout the application.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the application under various error conditions (e.g., API failures, network issues). Verify that the application handles errors gracefully and provides appropriate feedback to the user.

subtasks.title: Implement API Timeouts
subtasks.description: Implement timeouts for all API calls to prevent indefinite blocking.
subtasks.details: Set a reasonable timeout duration (e.g., 5-10 seconds) for all API requests using the fetch API or a similar mechanism. Consider using libraries like axios that provide timeout options. Ensure that the application handles timeout errors gracefully.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that API calls timeout as expected under simulated network latency or API unavailability. Check that the application displays an appropriate error message to the user.

subtasks.title: Implement Fallback Behavior for Components
subtasks.description: Implement fallback mechanisms for critical components to handle potential failures.
subtasks.details: For components that rely on external data or services, implement fallback UI or alternative data sources. For example, if the analytics API fails, display a default message or cached data. Consider using error boundaries in React to catch and handle errors within component trees.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate API failures or data unavailability and verify that the fallback mechanisms are triggered correctly. Check that the fallback UI or data is displayed as expected.

subtasks.title: Gracefully Handle Missing Analytics Data
subtasks.description: Handle missing analytics responses gracefully in the AdminDashboard.
subtasks.details: Modify the AdminDashboard to handle cases where analytics data is missing or incomplete. Display a user-friendly message or a placeholder instead of crashing or displaying broken UI elements. Consider logging the error for debugging purposes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate missing or incomplete analytics data and verify that the AdminDashboard handles it gracefully. Check that the UI displays the expected placeholder or message.

subtasks.title: Implement Centralized Error Handling
subtasks.description: Implement a centralized error handling mechanism to catch and handle errors throughout the application.
subtasks.details: Create a global error handler (e.g., using try-catch blocks, error boundaries, or a dedicated error handling service). Log errors to a server-side logging service (e.g., Sentry, Rollbar) for monitoring and debugging. Display user-friendly error messages to the user, avoiding technical jargon.
subtasks.testStrategy: Trigger various types of errors (e.g., API errors, JavaScript errors) and verify that they are caught by the centralized error handler. Check that the errors are logged correctly and that the user receives appropriate feedback.

subtasks.title: Add Retry Mechanism for Failed API Calls
subtasks.description: Implement a retry mechanism for failed API calls.
subtasks.details: Implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff for API calls that fail due to transient issues (e.g., network problems). Limit the number of retries to prevent infinite loops. Consider using a library like 'p-retry' for this purpose.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate API failures and verify that the retry mechanism attempts to retry the calls. Check that the calls eventually succeed (if the issue is transient) or that the application handles the failure gracefully after exhausting the retries.

tasks.title: Clean Up Development Artifacts
tasks.description: Clean up development artifacts.
tasks.details: 1. Review the repository for development and testing files (e.g., test-dashboard-completion.js, memory-bank/ logs, AI assistant context files). 2. Remove or archive these files once they have served their purpose.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the application functions correctly after removing the development artifacts. Check for any missing functionality or unexpected behavior.

tasks.title: Final Code Review and Testing
tasks.description: Perform a final code review and testing.
tasks.details: 1. Review all changes made in the previous tasks. 2. Perform comprehensive testing of the application to ensure all features are working correctly. 3. Address any remaining issues or bugs.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform thorough testing of all features and functionalities. Ensure that all tests pass and that the application meets the required standards.

subtasks.title: Review Code Changes
subtasks.description: Review all code changes made in previous tasks.
subtasks.details: Examine code diffs, focusing on changes related to functionality, performance, and code style. Ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.

subtasks.title: Perform Functional Testing
subtasks.description: Test all application features to ensure they function correctly.
subtasks.details: Test core functionalities, including user authentication, data display, form submissions, and navigation. Verify expected behavior and data integrity.
subtasks.testStrategy: Execute test cases covering all features. Verify expected behavior and data integrity. Document test results.

subtasks.title: Conduct UI/UX Testing
subtasks.description: Test the user interface and user experience.
subtasks.details: Verify the layout, responsiveness, and visual elements of the application. Ensure a smooth and intuitive user experience across different devices and browsers.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test on different devices and browsers. Check for responsiveness and visual consistency. Ensure a smooth and intuitive user experience.

subtasks.title: Perform Performance Testing
subtasks.description: Test the application's performance under various conditions.
subtasks.details: Measure page load times, response times, and resource usage. Identify and address any performance bottlenecks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use performance testing tools to measure page load times, response times, and resource usage. Identify and address any performance bottlenecks.

subtasks.title: Address Remaining Issues and Bugs
subtasks.description: Fix any remaining issues or bugs identified during testing.
subtasks.details: Prioritize and fix bugs based on severity. Ensure all issues are resolved and verified through retesting.
subtasks.testStrategy: Retest all fixed issues to ensure they are resolved. Verify that no new issues were introduced during the fix.
